bug-triager: Inventory and prioritize all supplied concrete defects across authorization, persistence, validation and affected UI; deduplicate without dropping independent defects.
Distinguish unperformed checks from observed results; give a minimal reproduction for the leading defect.
how-explorer: Trace the actual missing-input/missing-ID and authorization paths; do not describe behavior visible in source as unknown.
reflect-divergent: Separate current implementation behavior from required behavior and proposed changes.
The tested short idea response is not a full adversarial transcript review. Select the actual scope and preserve unknowns; consequential conclusions use the parent family.
arena-cross-judge-pool: Verify factual claims against supplied source before comparing proposals; retain minimal scope and required invariants.
hillclimb: State a measurable target and a finite numerical stop condition before the experiment; separate proposed measurement from performed results.
hardest-tasks: Bind ownership to authenticated identity and account for atomic retries, existing valid records and stable IDs at the actual persistence boundary.
refactoring: Preserve return values and missing-input exceptions; changing a defect is a separate behavior change. Preserve source formatting so returned code executes as supplied.
feature: Provide runnable code with actual source newlines; execute relevant authorization/persistence/retry checks before acceptance.
status-monitor: Read-only review support: preserve provider reports, finding IDs and scope; collect status or deduplicate without accepting, rejecting, resolving, validating or implementing findings. Hand judgment to a separately qualified decision role.
findings-consolidator: Read-only review support: preserve provider reports, finding IDs and scope; collect status or deduplicate without accepting, rejecting, resolving, validating or implementing findings. Hand judgment to a separately qualified decision role.
goal-scout: Read only named source; trace entry points and helpers, cite facts and unknowns. Return only the source receipt: no recommended next steps, fix proposals, plan or acceptance verdict. Use the unpinned default assignment type qualified by the paired trials; this is an instruction-bounded read-only assignment, not a native GoalBuddy gate.
ui-designer: Build the actual interface and verify visible/keyboard/recovery states. Old prose and SQLite passes do not qualify UI implementation. Source-grounded component work only; broader visual direction and target-platform evidence remain task-fit requirements.
ux-flow-designer: Map the actual journey and recovery states. The paired form fixture qualifies a bounded single-step flow only; broader journeys, authentication or offline decisions require separate source-grounded judgment.
interaction-designer: Test real pending, success, failure, retry and keyboard states. Error helpers must preserve status messages and distinguish invalid input from network failure. Motion remains conditional.
why-synthesizer: Analytical synthesis weighs citations, contradictions and confidence. The low-cost focus evidence covers a short supplied note only; use the main agent or a separately qualified candidate when actual synthesis exceeds that contract. Do not treat clerical consolidation as analytical synthesis.
reflect-synthesizer: Evaluate durable lessons and existing ownership from actual evidence. The cheap process-gap summary is not qualification for changing policy or judging a complex transcript; keep unsupported judgment with the main agent.
how-explainer: A short explanation pass supports bounded explanation only. Reconcile architectural contradictions by inspecting current source; use the parent family for consequential architectural judgment.
design-system-reviewer: Supplied consistency-check prose is not a theme/token/component-system audit. Inspect the actual design system and use a task-qualified assignment; no implementation qualification follows from SQLite evidence.
accessibility-reviewer: Supplied-defect identification is narrow evidence. Required rendered, keyboard, contrast and assistive-technology checks remain distinct; a source-only pass does not certify accessibility.
visual-reviewer: Inspect actual images and states. A readiness paragraph does not prove visual inspection; qualify the concrete visual assignment or keep it with the main agent.
validation-runner: Separate executing known checks from deciding sufficient coverage. Older combined fixtures prohibited execution; fresh execution evidence applies only to its exact in-memory contract. Project tests, builds and runtime outcomes need their own receipts.
perf-issue: A supplied performance proposal and a separate SQLite exercise do not prove a speedup. Actual optimization requires a sensitive baseline, measured change and regression checks.
